question: Through whose grace has the determination of the Kaula teaching been understood?
premises: The speaker addresses the lord of Kaulas
Understanding occurred by that lord's grace
The Kaula determination is now known
inference: By the grace of the lord of Kaulas, the speaker has understood the Kaula determination.
plain_english: O Lord of the Kaulas, by your grace I have understood the determination of the Kaula teaching.
